class.name: GDScript
class.brief_description: A script implemented in the GDScript programming language.
class.description: A script implemented in the GDScript programming language, saved with the [code].gd[/code] extension. The script extends the functionality of all objects that instantiate it. Calling [method new] creates a new instance of the script. [method Object.set_script] extends an existing object, if that object's class matches one of the script's base classes. If you are looking for GDScript's built-in functions, see [@GDScript] instead.

method.name: get_annotations
method.description: Returns the user annotations applied to this script. Built-in annotations such as [code]@export[/code] and [code]@rpc[/code] are not included. Missing keys mean that target has no user annotations. The dictionary can contain: [codeblock] { "script": [], # Header annotations on this class only. "variables": {}, # Member name to an array of entries. "functions": {}, # Function name to an array of entries. "parameters": {}, # Function name to a dictionary of parameter name to an array of entries. } [/codeblock] Each entry is [code]{ "name": StringName, "values": Dictionary }[/code]. [code]name[/code] is the annotation class's [code]class_name[/code]. [code]values[/code] holds the folded attribute values, including defaults. Annotations written on a base script stay on that script. This method does not construct annotation objects; [method AnnotationUtils.instantiate_annotation] does.
